# Sarpbc.org

> Rocket League news and data platform

## About

Sarpbc.org is a comprehensive Rocket League esports website providing:
- Latest news and updates about Rocket League competitive scene
- Tournament information and brackets
- Player and team statistics
- Community forum for discussions
- Interactive games like Airriddle and Pick'ems

## Key Sections

### News
Stay up to date with the latest Rocket League esports news, roster changes, and tournament announcements.
URL: https://sarpbc.org/

### Tournaments
Browse ongoing and upcoming Rocket League tournaments with detailed brackets and match schedules.
URL: https://sarpbc.org/tournaments

### Players
Explore player profiles, statistics, and career information for professional Rocket League players.
URL: https://sarpbc.org/player

### Teams
Find information about Rocket League teams, their rosters, and match history.
URL: https://sarpbc.org/team

### Forum
Community-driven forum for Rocket League discussions, predictions, and interactions.
URL: https://sarpbc.org/forum

### Games

#### Airriddle
Daily Rocket League trivia game where you guess players based on clues.
URL: https://sarpbc.org/game/airriddle

#### Pick'ems
Tournament prediction game where users predict match outcomes.
URL: https://sarpbc.org/game/pickems

## Languages

The website is available in:
- English (default): https://sarpbc.org
- French: https://sarpbc.org/fr
